mapper.select: select crop_id, category, crop, followers from smx_expert_crop where crop = #{crop} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert ignore into smx_expert_crop (category, crop, followers) values (#{category}, #{crop}, 0)
mapper.select: select c.crop_id, c.category, c.crop, coalesce((select sum(q.view_count) from smx_expert_question q where q.crop = c.crop and q.del_flag = '0'), 0) as followers, (select count(1) from smx_expert_question q where q.crop = c.crop and q.del_flag = '0') as total from smx_expert_crop c order by case when c.crop = '冬枣' then 0 else 1 end, case c.category when '粮食作物' then 1 when '蔬菜' then 2 when '水果' then 3 when '其他' then 4 else 5 end, followers desc, c.crop
